notes: Fixed a bug that could export a different product's reviews than the one you were looking at.
Find media now works on Shopee tabs that were already open, instead of doing nothing.
A page range like 5-10 now starts at page 5 instead of page 1.
Large exports no longer fail partway - the archive is handed to the writer directly rather than being encoded first.
Review videos should now download, and failed downloads are reported instead of counted as saved.
Running twice no longer overwrites the first export; each run gets its own dated folder.
